decision_reason: This is a real Colorado CDSS Java desktop GUI with public source and GPLv3-licensed code, but the current first-party product page explicitly says it has not been actively developed in recent years, is not used in the standard CDSS modeling environment, and its OpenCDSS archive/development downloads are unavailable. The page’s linked 2016 StateMod model download is not evidence of a current release of this distinct Java GUI; the repository says its latest code is archived and release processes are untested. It fails the baseline’s current maturity/notability gate.

government_provenance.note: The first-party OpenCDSS product page identifies StateMod GUI as a Colorado CDSS tool, names the State of Colorado CWCB lead, links this exact repository, and carries the Colorado DNR footer; OpenCDSS workflow documentation says the program is State-funded and serves State tools.

public_source.note: The public GitHub repository contains the Java application source, build/development files, documentation, and exact README; the OpenCDSS product page links it as the main StateMod GUI source.

eligible_license.note: The repository contains the standard GNU GPL version 3 text; product README and OpenCDSS page describe the software as GPL v3+. GPL-3.0 is OSI-approved. Bundled third-party binaries/libraries remain separately licensed and are not covered merely by the root grant.

primary_evidence.note: The exact official product page states the GUI is not currently used in standard CDSS modeling and has not been developed for years; its own archive/development downloads are unavailable. The separate CDSS StateMod model page’s 2016 Fortran model download is not a current release/deployment of this Java GUI source.

product_identity: StateMod GUI, a distinct Java desktop viewer/editor/runner for StateMod datasets; not the separate Fortran StateMod model. Repository README describes it as an archive of latest GUI code.
agency: Colorado Department of Natural Resources / Colorado Decision Support Systems (CDSS); the official product page names the Colorado Water Conservation Board (CWCB) lead.
license: GNU GPL version 3 text in repository LICENSE.md; project page and README say GPL v3+. Third-party libraries/binaries have separate licenses.
status_note: Archived/inactive: official page says not currently used in standard CDSS modeling and no longer actively developed; the OpenCDSS GUI download is unavailable. Do not conflate a StateMod model download with this separate Java GUI.

decision_reason: The repository is the real public StateView HydroBase desktop viewer and its source is GPL-licensed. The official product page says StateView is used by CDSS modelers, but also says it is not actively maintained or developed and that archive/development downloads are unavailable. The page has no dated current-use or current-distribution evidence, and the repository history has had no source commits since 2019. Hold pending a verifiable current operational deployment/use signal or an available supported distribution.

government_provenance.note: The official OpenCDSS product page identifies the StateView application, links this exact main-code repository, lists a State of Colorado CWCB product lead, and bears the State DNR footer; the OpenCDSS workflow page confirms State funding and State/contractor use of its products.

public_source.note: The public repository contains the StateView Java source, source/development files, docs, README, and LICENSE.md; the product page names it as the main StateView code repository.

eligible_license.note: The repository has the standard GNU GPL version 3 license text; the README and official product page describe the software as GPL v3+. Both are OSI-approved GPL grants. Bundled third-party libraries/binaries have separate licenses and are not automatically covered by the application grant.

primary_evidence.note: The official page describes StateView as used by CDSS modelers and links the exact source, but also says it is no longer actively maintained/developed and its downloads are unavailable; no dated current deployment, recent operational use, or usable current release was located.

product_identity: StateView, a Colorado CDSS Java desktop tool for viewing a local HydroBase database. The repository also retains historical CWRAT code; CWRAT is phased out and should not be counted as a separate product from this repository.
agency: Colorado Department of Natural Resources / Division of Water Resources (DWR) within CDSS; the official product page names the Colorado Water Conservation Board (CWCB) lead.
license: GNU GPL version 3 text in repository LICENSE.md; product page and README describe GPL v3+. Third-party libraries/binaries and historical CWRAT material may have separate component scope.
status_note: Hold for dated current-use evidence or a retrievable official release: the official page says some CDSS modelers use StateView but also says it is not actively maintained/developed and downloads are unavailable. Source history is quiet since 2019. Keep CWRAT as historical code within this family, not another product.
